articles.title: Lawsuit challenges Tether for allegedly freezing $42.4 million USDT before U.S. warrant
articles.snippet: The plaintiffs allege that Tether acted in response to an informal U.S. law-enforcement request more than three months before a seizure warrant was issued.

articles.title: Former UK Prime Minister Liz Truss says bond rout could force emergency spending cuts
articles.snippet: The former prime minister said U.K. is among the worst examples of rising debt and warns the situation may have gone too far.

articles.title: XRP ETFs pull in $170 million over 11 days. Goldman tops institutional holders
articles.snippet: Spot XRP funds have logged 11 straight sessions of inflows, while Q2 filings show Goldman Sachs, Jane Street and Millennium among their biggest professional holders.

articles.title: Bitcoin enters ‘Rektember’ as rate-hike risk combines with seasonality to threaten rally
articles.snippet: September has historically been a poor month for risk assets in general, and bitcoin, in particular.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs notch best month of 2026 as BTC gains 25% in August
articles.snippet: US spot Bitcoin ETFs reduced their year-to-date net outflows by 66% as Bitcoin gained about 25% in August, while Ether ETFs turned positive YTD at $732 million and XRP ETFs reached $502 million.
